title: research: audit selected stock boundary
body:
# Audit parent-stock reuse at one selected bootstrap boundary

## Summary

Adds a source-pinned audit of the retained PR185 completed-call row boundary.
At that interface, the high-digit row range supplied by the parent is reused
as an operand of the completed child interchange and restored. The child adds
zero external rows beyond its two passed chunks; its internal borrowing is not
zero.

The selected native recurrence's sixth exponent matches the `a6` recurrence
value, but the frozen PR1087 assembler does not bind selected stage 6 to a
physical `A6 → A5` call map. The package records that limitation and leaves the
actual selected-stage stock increment and parent coefficient unknown.

## Evidence

- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` → `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`
  for the current selected record.
- `python3 -B research/selected-stock-boundary-audit/verify.py` →
  `PASS_SELECTED_STAGE6_RECURRENCE_AND_SOURCE_PINS`.
- `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-stock-boundary-audit --check-only`
  → `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- The source-defined zero-increment lemma is conditional on the completed-call
  contract and `k < e/2`; this PR does not prove that the selected stage-6
  cutoff implies the split condition.

The registered package replay requires Python 3.12, which was unavailable on
the authoring host. The direct verifier passed under Python 3.14.8. No
registered Python 3.12 replay is claimed.

## Limits

This does not derive a selected `sigma_6`, remove the retained 252 allowance,
bind the selected physical `A6 → A5` call map, validate the seventh layer,
admit a supplier, change κ, or establish a multiplication theorem.

## Credit

The completed ordinary-call contract is retained from PR185/PR182. Rohan Arun's
PR387 source describes the six-level composition; the selected assembly is
Rohan Arun's PR1094 lineage and the frozen T16 source is Jeremy Kothe's PR1087
work. No predecessor construction is claimed as new. Prepared by OpenAI Codex
(GPT-6 Luna xhigh), laptop-10, with AI assistance.

## Current overlap

Open PR #3742 locates the selected complex branch cutoff sequences. This package instead audits one selected stage-six parent-stock and completed-call boundary, and records that the frozen assembler does not bind a physical `A6 -> A5` call map.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-stock-boundary-audit` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-stock-boundary-audit --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
